config.trapChannels.name: Trap channels
config.trapChannels.description: Channels nobody should write in. A member who posts there is softbanned. Nothing happens until one is set.
config.logChannel.name: Log channel
config.logChannel.description: Channel where each triggered trap is logged.
config.counterChannel.name: Counter channel
config.counterChannel.description: Channel where the bot keeps a message counting the members caught by the trap, updated after each catch.
config.exemptRoles.name: Exempt roles
config.exemptRoles.description: Members with one of these roles are never sanctioned, nor are members who can manage messages in the trap channel.
config.purgeWindow.name: Purge window
config.purgeWindow.description: How far back the softban deletes the member's messages across the server (7 days at most).
log.title: 🍯 Trap triggered by {{author}} in {{channel}}
log.hidden: 🔒 *Content hidden: the log channel is visible to more people than the trap channel.*
log.messageKept: ⚠️ The trap message could not be deleted: delete it by hand.
outcome.softbanned: ✅ Softbanned: their messages from the last {{window}} were deleted.
outcome.notBannable: ⚠️ No sanction: the bot cannot ban this member (role too high or missing _Ban Members_ permission).
outcome.failed: ⚠️ The softban failed: check that the bot has the _Ban Members_ permission.
outcome.stillBanned: ⚠️ The member was banned but could not be unbanned: unban them by hand.
counter.title: 🍯 The honey pot
counter.count_one: 🐝 **{{count}}** little bee fell into the trap.
counter.count_other: 🐝 **{{count}}** little bees fell into the trap.
counter.footer: Bzzz… the honey looked so good.
